meta.name: Generate online reputation reports with SearchAPI, GPT-4o, SharePoint and Outlook

parameters.content:
## AI Reputation Report Generator

### How it works

This workflow generates AI-powered reputation reports from either an on-demand webhook request or a scheduled daily client scan. It normalizes input, builds search queries, fetches SearchAPI results, aggregates the findings, and uses an OpenAI-powered AI Agent to produce a structured report. The report is validated, converted into an HTML email, sent through Outlook, and, for scheduled CRM-driven runs, the client record is updated before the next batch item is processed.

### Setup steps

- Configure the webhook endpoint and ensure incoming requests include the required requestor email plus subject/client details.
- Add credentials for Microsoft Graph/SharePoint list access and Microsoft Outlook email sending, with permissions to read client records, patch report status fields, and send mail.
- Add SearchAPI credentials or API key for the search results HTTP request.
- Add OpenAI credentials for the AI Agent chat model and select the desired model.
- Update Microsoft Graph site/list URLs, CRM field names, recipient mappings, and status values to match your environment.

### Customization

Adjust the search query builder, client filtering logic, AI Agent prompt, report JSON schema validation, and HTML email template to change the report scope, tone, or delivery format.

## Webhook request intake

Receives an on-demand report request, normalizes requester and subject fields, checks that an email address was provided, and returns either an accepted response or an immediate error response.

## Scheduled client intake

Runs the daily reputation check, fetches the client list from Microsoft Graph, and filters/maps client records into the format needed for processing.

## Batch iteration controls

Processes scheduled clients one at a time and provides a completion endpoint when the batch has no more clients to process.

## Build search queries

Creates the search queries used for either webhook-triggered subjects or scheduled client records before handing them to the search collection path.

## Collect search evidence

Fetches search results from SearchAPI, merges each query with its returned results, and aggregates the evidence into a consolidated dataset for report generation.

## Generate and validate report

Uses the AI Agent with an OpenAI chat model to generate the reputation report, then parses and validates the AI output as structured JSON.

## Prepare and email report

Builds the validated report into an HTML email and sends it to the requester or configured recipient through Microsoft Outlook.

## Route CRM completion

Checks whether CRM processing status needs to be updated after the email is sent, and marks the workflow item complete when no further CRM loop action is required.

## Update CRM status

Updates the CRM or SharePoint report status through Microsoft Graph, then routes control back to the batch processor for the next scheduled client.
